newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK SOFTER ON MOST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK SOFTER ON MOST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the U.S. dollar, sterling and the mark but was firmer against South Africa's rand in quiet Monday morning interbank trade, dealers said.
"Nothing much has happened so far. It looks like the market is squarish at the moment but there could be receipts coming in later," commented one dealer.

At around 0745 GMT the local unit was trading at 11.4000/4100 on the U.S. dollar from 11.3975/4075 at Friday's close and was at 19.2550/2850 from 19.2300/2500 versus sterling, responding to a weaker U.S. dollar on the international market.
It was at 6.5340/5430 from 6.5000/5200 against the mark but gained against the rand to 2.5110/5150 from 2.5200/5400.
